theorems.name: Submission.doragm_support_ball_ratio_ge
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (κ : ℝ), 0 < n → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 ≤ κ → (∀ (z : Euclid P) (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → s < t → closedBall z t ⊆ W → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * s) / s ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall z s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall z t)) → ∀ y ∈ R.measure.support, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → unitBallVolume n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
